B08C055.summary: Sanjaya describes Ashvatthama's assault on the Pandava forces, where he overwhelms Yudhishthira's side with arrows and cuts down Satyaki's driver. Yudhishthira's allies counterattack, but Ashvatthama turns them back. Yudhishthira then rebukes him as a Brahmana in name only, and Ashvatthama stays silent. Yudhishthira withdraws and moves on toward Duryodhana's army.

scenes.B08C055S01: Ashvatthama's arrow storm against the Pandavas, his duel with Satyaki and the others, Yudhishthira's rebuke, and Yudhishthira's withdrawal toward the Kaurava army.

shots.B08C055S01H01: Sanjaya describes Ashvatthama's arrow barrage, which fills the sky and overwhelms Yudhishthira's protectors, and the Pandava warriors' attempt to hold their ground against it.

B08C056.summary: Karna and Bhimasena each carve through the Kaurava and Pandava forces, while Duryodhana fights the twins and Dhrishtadyumna, who cuts down Duryodhana's car and horses. Karna rushes into the Pancala ranks, and Arjuna clears the samsaptakas and the Kambojas. Ashvatthama then stuns Krishna and Arjuna with arrows until Krishna urges Arjuna to fight harder, and Arjuna wounds him and drives him off. The chapter ends with Yudhishthira, badly wounded, pulling back from the fighting.

scenes.B08C056S01: The long battle sequence in which Duryodhana, Dhrishtadyumna, Karna, Bhimasena, Arjuna and Ashvatthama all take turns gaining and losing ground, ending with Yudhishthira withdrawing wounded.

shots.B08C056S01H01: Sanjaya reports Duryodhana's duel with the twins and Dhrishtadyumna, the duel that leaves Duryodhana carless and carried off by his brothers, and the simultaneous slaughter by Karna and Bhima.
shots.B08C056S01H02: Karna scatters the Pancala leaders, and his ferocity is compared to a lion among deer and a fire among dry grass.
shots.B08C056S01H03: Yudhishthira and the Pandavas attack Karna, Arjuna clears the samsaptakas and the Kambojas, and Ashvatthama overwhelms Arjuna until Krishna rebukes Arjuna and Arjuna wounds Ashvatthama. Yudhishthira then retreats, wounded.

B08C057.summary: Duryodhana urges his allies to fight to the death and take the chance for glory. Ashvatthama swears an oath to kill Dhrishtadyumna, since he was the one who killed his father Drona while Drona had laid down his weapons. The armies clash in a great, violent melee while celestial beings watch from above. The chapter shows the war entering a fresh and fiercer stage.

scenes.B08C057S01: Duryodhana's speech to Karna and the other kings, Ashvatthama's vow of vengeance against Dhrishtadyumna, and the general clash of the two armies as the gods and heavenly beings look on.

shots.B08C057S01H01: Duryodhana tells Karna and the kings that this battle is a chance for heroes to win either the earth or heaven, and the Kuru warriors cheer. Ashvatthama then swears to kill Dhrishtadyumna, and the armies charge into a bloody clash watched by gods and Apsaras.

B08C058.summary: Arjuna, having beaten Drona's son and others, asks Krishna to take him to Yudhishthira, whom he cannot see. On the way Krishna points out the ruined battlefield, with the dead, the dying and the grieving relatives. Krishna then names the places where the Kaurava and Pandava heroes are fighting. The chapter closes with fresh fighting breaking out as the two hosts meet again.

scenes.B08C058S01: Arjuna asks Krishna to find Yudhishthira, Krishna describes the carnage on the field, and the battle resumes as the armies clash again.

shots.B08C058S01H01: Arjuna asks Krishna to find Yudhishthira, Krishna describes the dead, dying and grieving on the field, and then Krishna points out where the chief heroes are fighting before the fighting starts again.

B08C059.summary: Karna faces the Pandava leaders alone and drives them back, while Dhrishtadyumna and Satyaki fight him with great skill. Ashvatthama then turns on Dhrishtadyumna, the man who killed his father Drona, and disarms him. Ashvatthama is about to kill him when Arjuna strikes Ashvatthama down, and Sahadeva carries Dhrishtadyumna away to safety. Karna then challenges Arjuna, and Krishna turns the chariot toward the samsaptakas.

scenes.B08C059S01: Karna's single-handed stand against the Pandava leaders, Ashvatthama's attack on Dhrishtadyumna, Arjuna's rescue of him, and Krishna's turn toward the samsaptakas.

shots.B08C059S01H01: Karna meets the Pandava leaders alone, fights Dhrishtadyumna and Satyaki, and gains the upper hand, until Ashvatthama disarms Dhrishtadyumna and goes for him. Arjuna wounds Ashvatthama, who faints, Sahadeva carries Dhrishtadyumna away, and Krishna drives toward the samsaptakas.
shots.B08C059S01H02: A line from the Project Gutenberg edition header, not part of the narrative.

B08C060.summary: Krishna shows Arjuna that Yudhishthira is under heavy attack from Duryodhana and the Kaurava host, and that Karna is driving forward toward Arjuna's side. Krishna urges Arjuna to face Karna and to rescue the king. He also gives news that Yudhishthira is alive and that Bhima is holding the field. The chapter ends with Sanjaya reporting that Bhima has checked the Kaurava army and that Arjuna has destroyed the samsaptakas.

scenes.B08C060S01: Krishna points out Yudhishthira's danger and Karna's advance, urges Arjuna to attack Karna, and reports that Bhima has the Kaurava army in retreat. Sanjaya then reports Arjuna's success against the samsaptakas.

shots.B08C060S01H01: Krishna tells Arjuna that Yudhishthira is surrounded, that Karna is coming for him, and that Bhima is routing the Kaurava army, and urges Arjuna to take on Karna.
shots.B08C060S01H02: Sanjaya reports Arjuna's destruction of the remaining samsaptakas and his continued slaughter of the Kaurava army.

B08C061.summary: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what the Kauravas did after Bhima and Yudhishthira pressed their attack. Sanjaya describes the wide, paired clashes that follow: Karna against Shikhandi, Duhshasana against Dhrishtadyumna, and the others against their match. He then tells of Nakula and Vrishasena, Sahadeva and Uluka, Satyaki and Shakuni, and Bhima's rout of the elephant divisions. The chapter shows the battle breaking into many separate duels across the field.

scenes.B08C061S01: Dhritarashtra's question, the paired duels across the battlefield, and the individual clashes between Nakula and Vrishasena, Sahadeva and Uluka, Satyaki and Shakuni, and Bhima against the Kuru elephant divisions.

shots.B08C061S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what the Kauravas did while Bhima and Yudhishthira were fighting.
shots.B08C061S01H02: Sanjaya describes the great mass of paired duels, including Karna against Shikhandi and Duhshasana against Dhrishtadyumna, and ends with the armies' clash described as the end of the age.
shots.B08C061S01H03: Nakula and Vrishasena trade arrows, and Karna scatters the Pandava troops while Nakula turns on the Kauravas.
shots.B08C061S01H04: Sahadeva kills Uluka's driver and horses, and Satyaki routs the Kaurava army while Shakuni is taken away.
shots.B08C061S01H05: Bhima leaves Duryodhana carless and then tears through the elephant divisions, while Kripa, Kritavarma and others clash with Yudhamanyu and Uttamauja.

B08C062.summary: Arjuna arrives on his chariot and Duryodhana attacks Yudhishthira with half his army. The Pandava warriors rush to protect the king, but Karna holds them all off single-handed. Karna then drives Yudhishthira back, wounds him, and sends him retreating, and Duryodhana and Bhima meet in battle. The chapter shows Karna's near-invincibility and how close Yudhishthira came to capture.

scenes.B08C062S01: Duryodhana's attack on Yudhishthira, Karna's single-handed defense against the rescuers, Yudhishthira's retreat, and Duryodhana's clash with Bhima.

shots.B08C062S01H01: Arjuna arrives on his chariot, Duryodhana surrounds Yudhishthira, and Karna checks the Pandava rescuers and drives Yudhishthira back until he retreats wounded.

B08C063.summary: Karna destroys five hundred Kaikaya warriors and chases the wounded Yudhishthira, who is retreating toward the camp. Karna cuts down Yudhishthira's horses and the twins' chariots, and Shalya, Karna's charioteer, rebukes him for wasting his strength on the king. Shalya urges Karna to go after Arjuna or to rescue Duryodhana from Bhima. Yudhishthira, reaching camp, sends the twins to help Bhima.

scenes.B08C063S01: Karna's assault on the Kaikayas and Yudhishthira's retreat, Shalya's advice to Karna, and Yudhishthira's withdrawal to the camp, where he orders the twins to help Bhima.

shots.B08C063S01H01: Karna kills many Kaikayas, chases the wounded Yudhishthira, destroys the king's horses and the twins' chariots, and is urged by Shalya to turn to Arjuna or to Bhima's fight with Duryodhana, while Yudhishthira retreats to the camp.

B08C064.summary: Ashvatthama and Arjuna fight a long duel in which Arjuna's divine weapons are blocked and Krishna is wounded. Ashvatthama is eventually forced to drop his bow after Arjuna cuts his horses and driver away, and his troops break and flee. Duryodhana urges Karna to stop the rout, and Karna answers with the Bhargava weapon, which wipes out the Pancalas and Cedis. Arjuna then turns from the duel with Ashvatthama to look for Yudhishthira.

scenes.B08C064S01: The Arjuna and Ashvatthama duel, the rout of the Kaurava army, Karna's use of the Bhargava weapon, and Arjuna's decision to search for Yudhishthira.

shots.B08C064S01H01: Arjuna and Ashvatthama fight a long duel of divine weapons, Arjuna cuts Ashvatthama's horses and driver away, the Kaurava army breaks, and Karna's Bhargava weapon devastates the Pandava side until Arjuna seeks Yudhishthira.

B08C065.summary: Arjuna, having beaten Ashvatthama, asks Bhima where Yudhishthira is, and Bhima says the king may have been mortally wounded and has gone to camp. Arjuna and Bhima argue over who should go to the king, with each unwilling to be seen as running from the fight. Krishna then takes Arjuna to Yudhishthira, who is alone and wounded, and Yudhishthira is glad to see them, believing Karna is dead. The chapter ends with the reunion, before the king's own account of what happened.

scenes.B08C065S01: Arjuna's search for Yudhishthira, his argument with Bhima over who should go, Krishna's decision to take Arjuna to the king, and the reunion in the camp.

shots.B08C065S01H01: Arjuna asks Bhima where Yudhishthira is, and Bhima says the king left the field badly wounded, and the two argue over who should go and who should hold the line against the samsaptakas.
shots.B08C065S01H02: Arjuna asks Krishna to drive him to the king.
shots.B08C065S01H03: Krishna tells Bhima to fight the samsaptakas and drives Arjuna to Yudhishthira, who is lying alone, and the king greets them with joy, believing Karna is dead.

B08C066.summary: Yudhishthira greets Krishna and Arjuna, assuming they have killed Karna, and asks for the details. He recounts how Karna had beaten him, cut down his standard and horses, and humiliated him in front of the army, and how he survived only through Bhima's help. He says he has feared Karna for thirteen years and asks Arjuna to describe Karna's death. The chapter shows the king's pain and resentment as the basis for the rebuke that follows.

scenes.B08C066S01: Yudhishthira's welcome to Krishna and Arjuna, his account of his humiliation by Karna, and his demand to hear how Karna was slain.

shots.B08C066S01H01: Yudhishthira welcomes Krishna and Arjuna, recounts his defeat by Karna, and demands to hear how Karna was killed.

B08C067.summary: Arjuna reports his battle with Ashvatthama, whom he drove off, and his destruction of five hundred warriors before he moved toward Karna's division. He says no other Srinjaya can resist Karna, and he asks Satyaki, Dhrishtadyumna, Yudhamanyu and Uttamauja to guard his chariot. He then vows to fight Karna and kill him that day, with all his kin, or else accept the shame of a broken vow. He asks Yudhishthira for his blessing.

scenes.B08C067S01: Arjuna's account of his battle with Ashvatthama and the samsaptakas, his request for guards, and his vow to kill Karna and asks for a blessing.

shots.B08C067S01H01: Arjuna recounts his duel with Ashvatthama, his escape from Karna's division, his request that others guard his chariot, and his vow to kill Karna that day.

B08C068.summary: Yudhishthira, furious that Arjuna has left Bhima behind and fled from Karna, accuses him of cowardice and breaking his earlier promise. He recalls the old prophecy of a heavenly voice that promised Arjuna great feats, and says it has come to nothing. He then mocks Arjuna's bow Gandiva, his car, and his banner, and says he would be better off not born. The chapter sets up the quarrel that follows between the two brothers.

scenes.B08C068S01: Yudhishthira's reproach to Arjuna for deserting Bhima and failing to kill Karna, his recollection of the heavenly prophecy, and his scornful words about Arjuna's weapons and car.

shots.B08C068S01H01: Yudhishthira reproaches Arjuna for fleeing Karna and leaving Bhima, recalls the prophecy about Arjuna, and mocks his bow, car and banner.

B08C069.summary: Arjuna draws his sword to kill Yudhishthira for saying he should give up the Gandiva, and Krishna stops him. Krishna argues at length that Arjuna's vow is misguided and that truth and falsehood depend on circumstance, citing the stories of the hunter Valaka and the ascetic Kausika. Arjuna asks for a way to keep his vow without killing his brother, and Krishna proposes that Arjuna insult Yudhishthira by addressing him as 'thou' instead of with respect. The chapter shows Krishna's guidance on dharma, which steers the brothers toward a face-saving solution.

scenes.B08C069S01: Arjuna's sword is drawn against Yudhishthira, Krishna's rebuke and explanation of dharma through the Valaka and Kausika stories, and Krishna's advice on how Arjuna can keep his vow without killing his brother.

shots.B08C069S01H01: Arjuna draws his sword against Yudhishthira, and Krishna asks why, noting that the Kauravas are already being beaten by Bhima and that the king is safe.
shots.B08C069S01H02: Krishna calls Arjuna's anger a sin and explains that killing is worse than untruth, and that truth and falsehood depend on the situation, with five cases where falsehood may be spoken.
shots.B08C069S01H03: Arjuna asks Krishna to tell him the stories of Valaka and Kausika.
shots.B08C069S01H04: Krishna tells the story of the hunter Valaka, who killed a blind beast and went to heaven, and of Kausika, who told robbers the truth and fell into hell, and then Arjuna asks for counsel on how to keep his vow without killing Yudhishthira.
shots.B08C069S01H05: Krishna explains that Yudhishthira spoke in anger to provoke Arjuna into killing Karna, and advises Arjuna to address his brother as 'thou' to inflict a kind of death without killing him.

B08C070.summary: Arjuna, applauding Krishna's advice, turns on Yudhishthira with harsh words, saying he sits far from the fighting while Bhima does the real work. He blames the king for the gambling that brought the Kauravas' war on the family, and lists his own feats in battle. Realising his wrong, Arjuna is overcome with shame and draws his sword to kill himself, but Krishna stops him. Yudhishthira, in turn, offers his own head and prepares to leave for the forest, until Krishna and Arjuna beg his forgiveness and he accepts their apology.

scenes.B08C070S01: Arjuna's harsh speech to Yudhishthira, his shame and attempted self-harm, Krishna's intervention, Arjuna's boast of his feats, Yudhishthira's offer to leave, and the reconciliation.

shots.B08C070S01H01: Sanjaya says that Arjuna, approving of Krishna's counsel, now speaks harshly to Yudhishthira in a way he never had before.
shots.B08C070S01H02: Arjuna scolds Yudhishthira for sitting far from battle, praises Bhima's exploits, and blames the king's love of dice for the family's ruin.
shots.B08C070S01H03: Arjuna, ashamed, draws his sword to kill himself, Krishna rebukes him for thinking of suicide, and Arjuna boasts of his own feats and vows to kill Karna.
shots.B08C070S01H04: Yudhishthira, deeply hurt, offers to be killed or to go to the forest, Krishna and Arjuna beg his forgiveness, and the king accepts them both.

B08C071.summary: Krishna tells Arjuna that his shame over the harsh words was misplaced, and urges him to make peace with Yudhishthira before going after Karna. The brothers embrace and make up, and Arjuna swears to kill Karna and his followers that day. Yudhishthira blesses him and urges him on to victory, as Indra once did against Vritra.

scenes.B08C071S01: Krishna urges Arjuna to make peace with Yudhishthira, the brothers reconcile, Arjuna swears a solemn vow to kill Karna, and Yudhishthira forgives him and sends him to battle.
scenes.B08C071S02: Yudhishthira's blessing on Arjuna as he sets out to kill Karna.

shots.B08C071S01H01: Krishna tells Arjuna his shame was misplaced and urges him to please Yudhishthira before fighting Karna, and Arjuna bows and asks his brother's forgiveness.
shots.B08C071S01H02: The brothers weep and embrace, Arjuna swears to kill Karna that day, and Krishna urges Yudhishthira to comfort and bless Arjuna.
shots.B08C071S01H03: Yudhishthira forgives Arjuna and tells him to go and slay Karna.
shots.B08C071S01H04: Arjuna bows to his brother, who embraces him and praises him.
shots.B08C071S01H05: Arjuna swears on Yudhishthira's feet to kill Karna and his followers that day, or not return from battle.
shots.B08C071S02H01: Yudhishthira blesses Arjuna with long life, victory and the destruction of his foes, and sends him off to kill Karna as Indra killed Vritra.

B08C072.summary: Arjuna prepares his chariot for the fight with Karna, and Krishna has his charioteer Daruka yoke the horses. Omens of success appear, with birds gathering and the directions growing calm, while all creatures expect Karna's death. Krishna then warns Arjuna not to underrate Karna, describing him as a warrior of great skill and power who is nearly Arjuna's equal. The chapter sets the stage for the final duel between the two.

scenes.B08C072S01: Arjuna orders his chariot readied, Krishna has Daruka yoke the horses, omens of victory appear, and Krishna warns Arjuna about Karna's strength.

shots.B08C072S01H01: Arjuna orders his chariot readied, Daruka yokes the horses, Arjuna is blessed and sets out, and birds and omens gather around him as all creatures expect Karna to die.
shots.B08C072S01H02: Krishna praises Arjuna's skill and warns him not to underestimate Karna, describing the Suta's son as strong, proud and nearly his equal.

B08C073.summary: Krishna gives Arjuna a long review of the war so far, naming the great warriors on both sides who have fallen. He credits Arjuna with slaying Jayadratha and recalls Karna's role in Abhimanyu's death and Karna's insults to Draupadi in the assembly. He urges Arjuna to kill Karna that day and not to spare his own kin or teachers on the other side. The chapter gives the moral and personal stakes behind the final duel.

scenes.B08C073S01: Krishna's long speech reviewing the war, the deaths of Bhishma, Drona and others, Karna's crimes against the Pandavas, and his urging of Arjuna to kill Karna.

shots.B08C073S01H01: Krishna reviews the losses on both sides, the deeds of Bhishma, Drona and others, Karna's wrongs against the Pandavas, and urges Arjuna to kill Karna that day.

B08C074.summary: Arjuna, reassured by Krishna, stretches his bow and vows to kill Karna that day, saying that his arrows will settle every score. He boasts of his own skill and of his past wrongs, and repeats the insults he suffered at Karna's hands. He says that Karna will fall and that Duryodhana, Dhritarashtra and the Kauravas will be destroyed. He then sets out for the battlefield to rescue Bhima and cut Karna down.

scenes.B08C074S01: Arjuna's vow and long boast that he will slay Karna that day, followed by his departure to rescue Bhima.

shots.B08C074S01H01: Arjuna, reassured by Krishna, vows in a long speech to slay Karna, answer his insults, and defeat the Kauravas, then rides off to rescue Bhima.

B08C075.summary: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya how the battle went when Arjuna went into it. Sanjaya describes the general melee, with the Pandava and Srinjaya forces hurling themselves at the Kaurava leaders in many pairings. Uttamauja kills Karna's son Sushena, and Karna's grief turns to rage as he cuts down Uttamauja's horses and chariot. Bhima then appears in the thick of the fighting, scorching Duryodhana's sons' forces.

scenes.B08C075S01: Dhritarashtra's question, and Sanjaya's account of the many duels across the field, including Sushena's death, Kripa's rescue by Drona's son, and Bhima's advance.

shots.B08C075S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya how the fight went when Arjuna set out, in a long opening question.
shots.B08C075S01H02: Dhritarashtra's question continues, asking what happened once Arjuna was in the battle.
shots.B08C075S01H03: Dhritarashtra ends his question by asking how the fight went.
shots.B08C075S01H04: Sanjaya describes the Pandava army's roar and the battle as a storm, with Uttamauja killing Sushena and Karna cutting down Uttamauja's horses, and Bhima scorching the Kaurava host.

B08C076.summary: Bhima, surrounded and anxious about Yudhishthira and Arjuna, asks his charioteer Visoka to drive him into the thick of the Kaurava host. Visoka reports how many weapons Bhima has left, and Bhima pledges to fight to the end. Visoka then tells him that Arjuna is coming, and Bhima rewards the news with villages, slaves and chariots. The chapter shows Bhima's ferocity and the relief of hearing that his brother is near.

scenes.B08C076S01: Bhima drives into the Kaurava host, asks Visoka how many weapons he has left, and learns that Arjuna is coming, which brings him relief and a reward.

shots.B08C076S01H01: Bhima orders his charioteer into the Kaurava host, scatters his enemies with arrows, and worries about Yudhishthira and Arjuna before asking how many arrows he still has.
shots.B08C076S01H02: Visoka lists Bhima's remaining arrows and other weapons, and assures him they will not run out.
shots.B08C076S01H03: Bhima vows to fight to the end, so that the Kauravas fall or all the world praises him, and he urges Arjuna to come quickly.
shots.B08C076S01H04: Visoka describes Arjuna's chariot, his banner and the signs of Krishna, and reports Arjuna's victories so far.
shots.B08C076S01H05: Bhima rewards Visoka with villages, slaves and chariots for the good news.

B08C077.summary: Arjuna urges Krishna onward, and the Kaurava warriors surge forward to block him, but Arjuna cuts them down and pushes toward Karna's division. Bhima, hearing of his brother's coming, renews his assault and creates a river of blood across the field. Duryodhana then orders Shakuni to slay Bhima, and Shakuni is wounded and carried off from the battle. The Kaurava army, shaken by Bhima and Arjuna, rallies under Karna, their refuge, and goes back into battle.

scenes.B08C077S01: Arjuna's advance and slaughter of the Kaurava warriors, Bhima's great rampage and river of blood, Shakuni's defeat by Bhima, and the Kaurava army rallying around Karna.

shots.B08C077S01H01: Arjuna drives into the Kaurava host and cuts down wave after wave of warriors, Bhima rejoices and renews his attack, and the Kaurava troops rally around Karna and go back to battle.

B08C078.summary: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what Duryodhana, Karna and the others did once Bhima had broken the Kaurava lines. Sanjaya reports that Karna, driven by Shalya, charges into the Pancala and Srinjaya ranks and wounds many Pandava warriors, including Satyaki, Bhima and the sons of Draupadi. The Pandava army falls back before him, and the Kaurava side rejoices. The chapter shows Karna's sudden recovery of the Kaurava fortunes.

scenes.B08C078S01: Dhritarashtra's question about what the Kaurava leaders did, and Sanjaya's account of Karna's assault on the Pandava army, with Shalya driving.

shots.B08C078S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what Duryodhana, Karna and the other Kaurava leaders did when Bhima had broken their army.
shots.B08C078S01H02: Karna orders Shalya to drive him into the Pancalas, and he cuts down the Pandava warriors, wounding Bhima, Satyaki and others, until the Pandava army breaks and flees and the Kauravas rejoice.

B08C079.summary: Arjuna, having slain many of the enemy, sees Karna and orders Krishna to drive toward him, vowing not to return without killing him. Shalya warns Karna that Arjuna is coming alone and that Krishna is at his side, but Karna answers with confidence and boasts of his own strength. Karna then recounts Arjuna's feats and divine weapons and sends the Kaurava warriors to block Arjuna's path and tire him out. The chapter sets up the final clash between the two heroes, with Kaurava warriors pressing in on Arjuna from every side.

scenes.B08C079S01: Arjuna's river of blood and his order to drive toward Karna, Shalya's warning and Karna's answer, Karna's recounting of Arjuna's feats, his command to block Arjuna, and the general clash as Arjuna cuts down his attackers.

shots.B08C079S01H01: Arjuna creates a river of blood, orders Krishna to drive toward Karna, and Shalya urges Karna to face Arjuna, who is coming alone toward him.
shots.B08C079S01H02: Karna answers that he will fight Arjuna and Krishna, and that he will not return without killing two heroes or dying in the attempt.
shots.B08C079S01H03: Shalya asks who could defeat Arjuna when he is protected by Krishna.
shots.B08C079S01H04: Karna praises Arjuna's skill and the divine weapons he has gained, says Krishna's protection makes him invincible, and orders the Kaurava warriors to surround and wear out Arjuna. Arjuna cuts through the Kaurava attackers, and Drona's son, Kripa and others fall on him, and the whole field is darkened by arrows.

B08C080.summary: Arjuna leaves Karna's division to rescue Bhima and scatters the Kaurava host with a torrent of arrows, breaking their ranks and forcing them to flee. He then meets Bhima, who has been fighting alone, and tells him that Yudhishthira's wounds have been dressed and he is well. Ten of Duryodhana's brothers then try to block Arjuna, and he kills them all with his arrows. The chapter shows Arjuna's ferocious advance and his brothers' reunion.

scenes.B08C080S01: Arjuna's rescue of Bhima and rout of the Kaurava host, his report that Yudhishthira is well, and his destruction of ten of Duryodhana's brothers.

shots.B08C080S01H01: Arjuna drives off the Kaurava warriors who are attacking Bhima, rains arrows on the field, breaks the Kuru army, and meets Bhima to report that Yudhishthira is well.
shots.B08C080S01H02: Ten of Duryodhana's brothers attack Arjuna's chariot, and he cuts down their standards, horses, bows and heads with arrows and moves on.

B08C081.summary: Ninety Samsaptaka chariots charge Arjuna, and he destroys them all as Krishna drives toward Karna. A wider Kaurava force then rushes in to block his way, and Mlecchas on elephants attack his flank, but Arjuna routs them. Bhima, having cleared the rest of the Kaurava army, joins Arjuna and crushes the elephant divisions, and the Kaurava host breaks and flees. Karna then shelters the fleeing Kauravas and steps forward to face the Pancalas, who are overwhelmed by his shafts.

scenes.B08C081S01: Arjuna destroys the ninety Samsaptaka chariots and the Mleccha elephant force, Bhima's mace rampage, the Kaurava rout, and Karna's stand as the protector of the fleeing Kauravas.

shots.B08C081S01H01: Arjuna destroys ninety Samsaptaka chariots, the Kaurava force, and the Mleccha elephant riders, Bhima crushes the rest of the Kaurava army with his mace, and the Kauravas break and flee to Karna, who vows to protect them and attacks the Pancalas.

B08C082.summary: Karna destroys the Pancala warriors one by one, cutting down Janamejaya's driver, Satyaki's horses, and the sons of Karna, Prasena and others. Krishna urges Arjuna to go and kill Karna, and Arjuna and Bhima drive toward Karna's chariot, fighting along the way. Five Pancala commanders try to stop Karna, but he defeats them, and the sons of Draupadi rescue them. Duhshasana and Bhima then fight a fierce duel, in which Duhshasana wounds Bhima badly, and Bhima recovers and roars.

scenes.B08C082S01: Karna's slaughter of the Pancala commanders and Prasena, Krishna's order to Arjuna, the duel of Karna with the five Pancala commanders, Satyaki's fight, and the clash of Bhima and Duhshasana.

shots.B08C082S01H01: Karna kills many Pancala leaders and their horses and sons, Krishna urges Arjuna to go against Karna, Arjuna and Bhima drive toward Karna, and the sons of Draupadi rescue the Pandava commanders. Duhshasana and Bhima fight, Duhshasana wounds Bhima, and Bhima recovers and roars.

B08C083.summary: Duhshasana fights Bhima fiercely, but Bhima hurls his mace, knocks him from his chariot, and kills him. Bhima, recalling the insults to Draupadi, drinks Duhshasana's blood and boasts of it, and the Kaurava warriors flee in terror. Yudhamanyu kills Citrasena, and Bhima promises to kill Duryodhana next. The chapter is one of the most violent and vengeful in the book, and it marks the fulfilment of Bhima's oath.

scenes.B08C083S01: Duhshasana's duel with Bhima, Bhima's killing of Duhshasana and his vow-fulfilling drink of blood, the flight of the Kaurava warriors, and Bhima's vow against Duryodhana.

shots.B08C083S01H01: Duhshasana and Bhima fight, Bhima kills Duhshasana with his mace, drinks his blood as his vow requires, and boasts to the Kauravas that he will kill Duryodhana next.

B08C084.summary: Ten of Duryodhana's brothers attack Bhima to avenge Duhshasana, and Arjuna cuts them all down. Karna is shaken, and Shalya urges him to fight on, since the whole burden of the war rests on him. Karna's son Vrishasena fights Nakula, cuts down his chariot and horses, and then destroys his shield and sword. Nakula leaps onto Bhima's chariot, and Arjuna and Bhima counterattack, and Arjuna turns to face Vrishasena.

scenes.B08C084S01: Arjuna's destruction of ten Kaurava brothers, Shalya's encouragement of Karna, Vrishasena's duel with Nakula, and Arjuna's move against Vrishasena.

shots.B08C084S01H01: Ten of Duryodhana's brothers attack Bhima, Arjuna destroys them, Shalya urges Karna to fight, and Vrishasena fights Nakula, cutting down his horses and car, until Nakula climbs onto Bhima's chariot and Arjuna turns to face Vrishasena.

B08C085.summary: The Pandava warriors and the sons of Draupadi charge to aid Nakula, and the Kaurava leaders stand against them. Kripa, Ashvatthama, Kritavarma and others fight the Pancalas and Srinjayas while Kulinda elephants are cut down one by one. Vrishasena wounds Arjuna and Krishna, and Arjuna, enraged, vows to kill him before killing Karna and Duryodhana. Arjuna cuts Vrishasena down, and the sight of his son's death drives Karna into a rage as he rushes at Arjuna and Krishna.

scenes.B08C085S01: The general clash that follows Nakula's defeat, Arjuna's vow against Vrishasena, Arjuna's killing of Vrishasena, and Karna's rush toward Arjuna and Krishna.

shots.B08C085S01H01: The Pandava warriors rush to rescue Nakula, the Kaurava leaders engage them, Vrishasena wounds Arjuna and Krishna, Arjuna vows to kill Vrishasena, and then he shoots him down, and Karna rushes forward in grief and anger.
shots.B08C085S01H02: Seeing his son slain, Karna charges at Krishna and Arjuna in great fury.

B08C086.summary: Krishna sees Karna's chariot approaching, with Shalya at the reins, and urges Arjuna to stay calm and fight. He reminds Arjuna of Shiva's favour and of the boons Arjuna has won, and says only Arjuna can face Karna's arrows. Arjuna answers with confidence, vowing that Karna will be slain that day, and drives his chariot forward to meet him. The chapter sets up the final duel.

scenes.B08C086S01: Krishna's speech urging Arjuna to face Karna with calm, and Arjuna's reply vowing victory before he drives toward Karna.

shots.B08C086S01H01: Krishna points out Karna's chariot, with Shalya driving, and urges Arjuna to stay calm, recalling the divine favours he has won.
shots.B08C086S01H02: Arjuna vows that he will kill Karna that day and urges Krishna to drive quickly toward him.

B08C087.summary: Karna and Arjuna close in on each other amid the cheers of their armies, and the gods and other beings take sides. Indra and Surya argue over which side should win, and Brahma and Shiva favour Arjuna while also urging that the outcome not destroy the world. Krishna tells Arjuna that Karna cannot harm him, and Arjuna answers by vowing to destroy Karna and Shalya that day. The chapter sets the stage for the climax of the duel.

scenes.B08C087S01: The two chariots meet, the armies and the gods take sides, and Krishna and Arjuna exchange words before the duel begins.

shots.B08C087S01H01: The two heroes face each other across the field while armies cheer, gods and other beings take sides, Indra and Surya dispute the outcome, and Karna asks Shalya what he will do if Karna falls, and Shalya vows to kill Krishna and Arjuna.
shots.B08C087S01H02: A book heading: 'BOOK 9', marking the start of the next section of the text.
shots.B08C087S01H03: Krishna tells Arjuna that Karna cannot defeat him, and Arjuna promises to destroy Karna and Shalya that day and to comfort those who have grieved.

B08C088.summary: Arjuna and Karna fight at the centre of a huge battle, with the gods and other beings watching from the sky. Arjuna drives back five Kaurava leaders, Duryodhana among them, and destroys their chariots, and the gods shower him with flowers. Drona's son then begs Duryodhana to make peace with the Pandavas, pointing out that Arjuna is invincible. Duryodhana refuses, citing Bhima's threats and Karna's confidence, and orders his troops to attack.

scenes.B08C088S01: The great clash of Arjuna and Karna with the gods watching, Arjuna's defeat of the Kaurava leaders, Ashvatthama's plea for peace, and Duryodhana's refusal.

shots.B08C088S01H01: The sky fills with celestial beings as Arjuna and Karna clash, Arjuna beats back the five Kaurava leaders and is showered with flowers, Ashvatthama begs Duryodhana to make peace, and Duryodhana refuses and orders his men to attack.

B08C089.summary: Arjuna and Karna, both furious, trade volleys of arrows, and Karna's shafts seem to hold their own against Arjuna's. Arjuna's weapons are repeatedly blocked by Karna's counter-weapons, including the Bhargava weapon, and the Pancalas and Somakas who come to Arjuna's aid are slaughtered. Bhima, angry at the setback, urges Arjuna on, and Krishna reminds him of his strength and of Shiva's gifts. Arjuna then unleashes the brahmastra, the mightiest weapon, and the Kaurava army is driven back, until Karna, undaunted, presses his attack.

scenes.B08C089S01: The opening clash of Arjuna and Karna, the cosmic weapons contest, Bhima's and Krishna's urging of Arjuna, and Arjuna's decision to use the brahmastra.
scenes.B08C089S02: Arjuna's and Karna's escalating weapons exchange, the battle's slaughter, Yudhishthira's arrival, and Karna's last stand against the Kaurava retreat.

shots.B08C089S01H01: Arjuna and Karna close with each other like two mighty elephants or mountains, each pouring arrows on the other.
shots.B08C089S01H02: The combat is compared to the battle of Indra and Vritra, and both heroes and their drivers are badly wounded.
shots.B08C089S01H03: The armies and spectators are frightened as the two warriors clash, and some cheer Arjuna forward.
shots.B08C089S01H04: The Somakas urge Arjuna to slay Karna, and the Kaurava warriors urge Karna to slay Arjuna.
shots.B08C089S01H05: Karna and Arjuna exchange opening volleys of ten arrows each and begin to wound each other.
shots.B08C089S02H01: Arjuna sends a storm of arrows at Karna, but Karna cuts them all away with his own.
shots.B08C089S02H02: Arjuna launches a fiery weapon, and Karna quenches it with the varuna weapon.
shots.B08C089S02H03: Karna then summons clouds that hide the sky and flood the field, and the fire is put out.
shots.B08C089S02H04: Arjuna clears the clouds with a wind weapon, and then drives back Karna with a volley of arrows. Karna responds with the Bhargava weapon and kills many Pancalas and Somakas. Bhima and Krishna urge Arjuna to act, and Arjuna sends the brahmastra and scatters the field with arrows, slaying many Kaurava warriors and wounding Karna. Karna keeps fighting, and Arjuna kills 2,000 Kaurava warriors, after which the Kauravas flee and Karna charges on alone.

B08C090.summary: Karna and Arjuna trade ever fiercer weapons, until the serpent Aswasena, who once hated Arjuna for the death of his mother, slips into Karna's quiver as an arrow. Karna shoots it, and Krishna presses down the chariot to save Arjuna, but the arrow knocks off Arjuna's diadem. Later Karna's chariot wheel sinks into the earth under a Brahmana's curse, and Karna, forgetting the brahmastra he once learned, begs Arjuna to wait while he frees the wheel. Krishna urges Arjuna to press on, and the chapter ends with Karna pleading for mercy on the rules of war.

scenes.B08C090S01: The Arjuna and Karna duel, the serpent-arrow episode, the loss of Arjuna's diadem, Karna's sinking chariot and his plea for a pause, and Krishna's urging.

shots.B08C090S01H01: The long duel: the two heroes fight with an endless storm of arrows, Karna fires the serpent-arrow Aswasena, Krishna sinks the chariot, and the arrow knocks off Arjuna's diadem; Karna's chariot wheel then sinks into the earth, and he pleads for a pause.
shots.B08C090S01H02: Arjuna answers with arrows that wound Karna, Karna is defeated and stunned, Arjuna holds back from killing him, Krishna urges him to finish the fight, and Karna begs for a pause as he frees his sunken wheel.

B08C091.summary: Krishna confronts Karna with a long list of his past wrongs: the dice match, the abuse of Draupadi in the assembly, the attempts on the Pandavas' lives, and the killing of Abhimanyu. Karna, shamed, fights on and wounds Arjuna, but Arjuna, stirred to rage, cuts off Karna's standard and then kills him with the Anjalika weapon, which takes off his head. The Kauravas, seeing their champion dead, begin to flee. The chapter marks Karna's death and the collapse of the Kaurava front.

scenes.B08C091S01: Krishna's rebuke of Karna's hypocrisy, Karna's near-victory and wounding of Arjuna, Arjuna's destruction of Karna's standard, the fatal arrow, and the Kaurava flight after Karna's death.

shots.B08C091S01H01: Krishna rebukes Karna for invoking virtue only now, listing his past wrongs against the Pandavas and Draupadi, and warns that he will not escape.
shots.B08C091S01H02: Karna's chariot wheel sinks as he wounds Arjuna, Arjuna cuts down his standard, and the Anjalika arrow takes off Karna's head, after which the Kauravas flee the field.

B08C092.summary: Shalya comes to Duryodhana's side on his bare chariot and mourns the fall of Karna and the destruction of the Kaurava army. Some Kauravas flee in terror, while Bhima and the Pandava troops celebrate with shouts and dance. Shalya tells Duryodhana that Destiny has favoured the Pandavas and that such losses are part of fate. Duryodhana, with his heart broken, sighs in grief.

scenes.B08C092S01: The reaction to Karna's death, Shalya's words of consolation to Duryodhana, and Duryodhana's grief.

shots.B08C092S01H01: Shalya, who has lost his standard, goes to comfort Duryodhana, the Kauravas flee, Bhima and the Pandavas celebrate, and Shalya tells Duryodhana that Destiny has turned against them.

B08C093.summary: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya how the Kaurava and Srinjaya armies looked after Karna's fall. Sanjaya describes the complete rout of the Kauravas, who flee in disorder, while Bhima slaughters 25,000 foot soldiers and Arjuna drives into the remaining chariots. Duryodhana, still determined, tries to rally his army with a speech about the honour of dying in battle, but his men flee regardless. The chapter shows the Kaurava army collapsing once Karna is gone.

scenes.B08C093S01: Dhritarashtra's question, Sanjaya's description of the Kaurava rout, the slaughter of the foot soldiers by Bhima, and Duryodhana's failed attempt to rally his men.

shots.B08C093S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what the Kuru and Srinjaya armies looked like after Karna was killed and the Kauravas fled.
shots.B08C093S01H02: Sanjaya describes the rout: the Kauravas flee in panic, Duryodhana plans to fight from the rear, Bhima kills 25,000 foot soldiers, the Pandavas drive the remaining chariots, and Duryodhana tries in vain to rally his men with a speech on the duty of battle.
shots.B08C093S01H03: Sanjaya adds that the Kaurava warriors fled anyway, ignoring Duryodhana's appeal.

B08C094.summary: Shalya, seeing Duryodhana near despair, describes the field strewn with dead elephants, horses and men, and urges him to withdraw to camp. Duryodhana weeps for Karna, and the Kaurava leaders lead the army back as the sun sets. Sanjaya describes Karna's corpse, which still shines like gold, and the cosmic portents that follow his death. Arjuna and Krishna then blow their conches in victory, and the Kauravas, deserting Duryodhana, leave the field.

scenes.B08C094S01: Shalya's description of the battlefield and his plea to Duryodhana, Duryodhana's grief, the Kauravas' return to camp, the portents and Karna's corpse, and Arjuna and Krishna's conch blasts.

shots.B08C094S01H01: Sanjaya says that Shalya, seeing Duryodhana stunned by grief, speaks to him.
shots.B08C094S01H02: Shalya describes the battlefield piled with the dead, the wounded and the broken chariots, and urges Duryodhana to turn back to camp, saying Duryodhana himself is to blame.
shots.B08C094S01H03: Duryodhana weeps for Karna, the kings lead him back to camp, and the Kauravas go, looking back at Arjuna's banner, while Karna's body still shines.
shots.B08C094S01H04: Portents follow Karna's death, Arjuna and Krishna blow their conches, and the Kauravas flee the field, leaving Duryodhana behind.

B08C095.summary: After Karna falls, the Kauravas break and flee, and Duryodhana, on Shalya's advice, withdraws the army. Their leaders retreat in turn, and the Kaurava warriors leave the field in shame and fear. Duryodhana, stunned by defeat, orders his men to rest for the night.

scenes.B08C095S01: The Kaurava flight and retreat to camp after Karna's death, with Duryodhana arranging the withdrawal on Shalya's advice.

shots.B08C095S01H01: After Karna's death the Kaurava army flees, Duryodhana withdraws the army on Shalya's advice, the leaders retreat to camp in grief, and Duryodhana orders his men to rest.

B08C096.summary: Krishna praises Arjuna's victory over Karna and tells him to report it to Yudhishthira, who had earlier been too wounded to stay on the field. The brothers go to Yudhishthira's tent, where he embraces them and learns of Karna's death from Krishna. Yudhishthira praises Krishna and Arjuna, and the Pandava army rejoices. Vaishampayana closes the Karna Parva with a note of its merit, and Dhritarashtra's grief at the news is described.

scenes.B08C096S01: Krishna's words to Arjuna, the report to Yudhishthira and his praise of the two heroes, the Pandava celebration, Dhritarashtra's grief, and the closing account of the Parva's merit.
scenes.B08C096S02: Edition title lines for the Mahabharata by Krishna-Dwaipayana Vyasa.

shots.B08C096S01H01: Krishna embraces Arjuna and tells him to report Karna's death to Yudhishthira, then goes with Arjuna to the king's tent and describes Karna's death to Yudhishthira, who is overjoyed.
shots.B08C096S01H02: Yudhishthira praises Krishna and Arjuna, saying that Krishna has made Arjuna's feats possible, and then goes out to see Karna's body.
shots.B08C096S01H03: The Pandava warriors welcome Yudhishthira and praise Krishna and Arjuna, and the army goes back to camp in joy.
shots.B08C096S01H04: Vaishampayana describes Dhritarashtra's grief at the news and says the reading of the Karna Parva brings merit to listeners.
shots.B08C096S01H05: A closing line: the end of the Karna Parva.
